kinds.title: Foundry Local
kinds.description: A model run by Foundry Local on this computer, served to the agent through a gateway the host runs for each session. No credential is kept: the model's name and where the service is are the account.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model variant to serve, as `foundry model list` shows it (`qwen3-14b-generic-gpu:2`). Load it in Foundry Local first: this never loads one.

endpoint.title: Service address
endpoint.description: The Foundry Local service, `http://127.0.0.1:PORT`. The running service is used when this is empty.

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: `service` (the default) uses the Foundry Local service you run, which holds the model. `sdk` runs the model inside this program through Foundry Local's SDK, which needs the native library below and loads the model into this program's memory.

library.title: Native library
library.description: For the `sdk` engine: the folder or file of Foundry Local's native library, a copy made outside the installed package, which a program cannot load from.

notices: the model runs in Foundry Local on this computer: load it there first, and unload it when you are done, since it holds memory other work needs
the agent is told any model name is this model; what the model cannot do (tools, images) is refused with the reason

logins.title: Use a Foundry Local model
logins.description: Names a model Foundry Local serves. It is not loaded or checked here: load it in Foundry Local before a session.
